description: This file provides utility functions for formatting currency amounts, specifically USD, with configurable decimal precision, optional credits appending, and fallback formatting. It ensures consistent currency display across the app, handling various edge cases in numeric formatting.

methods.name: formatCurrencyAmount(value, options = {})
methods.description: Formats a numeric value as currency string with optional credits suffix; handles dynamic decimal precision based on value magnitude.

methods.name: formatUsdWithCreditsText(usd, options = {})
methods.description: Convenience function to format USD amount with credits appended as string, forwarding options to 'formatCurrencyAmount'.

methods.name: formatUsdUpToSixDecimals(amount)
methods.description: Formats USD amount with up to six decimal places, including thousands separators.
